questions.stem: Which is the correct order of organisation from simplest to most complex?

options.text: Cell, organ, tissue, organ system, organism
Cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism
Organ, tissue, cell, organ system, organism
Tissue, cell, organ, organism, organ system

questions.explanation: The correct hierarchy from simplest to most complex is: cells group to form tissues, tissues combine to form organs, organs work together as organ systems, and organ systems make up the whole organism.
